name: JellyChat
overview: JellyChat drawer for Jellyfin SyncPlay sessions.
description: Adds a JellyChat drawer to Jellyfin web clients for SyncPlay sessions using a plugin-owned in-memory event stream. It does not use Jellyfin toast chat transport, an external WebSocket server, or additional network ports.

versions.changelog: JellyChat v0.2.1 release. Highlights: - Polishes the drawer layout and player/fullscreen docking behavior. - Improves injected frontend layout handling around Jellyfin web containers. - Updates README install guidance and project acknowledgements. Validation: - npm run build - dotnet publish Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat/Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat.csproj -c Release - GitHub Actions build workflow passed for the release-prep commit.

JellyChat v0.2.0 release. Highlights: - Replaces the injected drawer with the React-based JellyChat frontend. - Adds the plugin-owned event stream backend for SyncPlay chat messages and grouped recent history. - Improves video-player and fullscreen behavior, including docked drawer layout handling. - Cleans up repository metadata and editor-specific files. Validation: - npm run build - dotnet publish Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat/Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyChat.csproj -c Release - GitHub Actions build workflow passed for the release-prep commit.

JellyChat v0.1.0 MVP release. Adds a Jellyfin SyncPlay chat drawer backed by plugin-owned in-memory history. Does not use Jellyfin toast chat transport, an external WebSocket server, or new ports. Tested with Jellyfin 10.11.x. Built against Jellyfin.Controller / Jellyfin.Model 10.11.8. Target ABI: 10.11.0.0.
